Rule.Name: Ensure Apache does not run as root (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set the User and Group directives to the default 'www-data' user and group.
Rule.Correction: sed -i 's/^User .*/User www-data/' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; sed -i 's/^Group .*/Group www-data/' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; usermod -s /usr/sbin/nologin www-data
Rule.Verification: grep -q '^User www-data' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && grep -q '^Group www-data' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && echo 0 || echo 1

Rule.Name: Ensure Apache user shell is set to /usr/sbin/nologin (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The Apache user has a valid login shell.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Change the Apache user shell to /usr/sbin/nologin.

Rule.Name: Ensure Apache user account is locked (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The Apache user account is not locked.
Rule.Verification: getent shadow www-data | cut -d: -f2 | grep -q '^!' && echo 0 || echo 1

Rule.Name: Ensure Apache directories and files are owned by root (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Some Apache directories and files are not owned by root.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Change ownership of all Apache directories and files to root.

Rule.Name: Ensure Apache directories have group ownership set to root (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Apache directories and files do not have group ownership set to root.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set group ownership of Apache directories and files to root.

Rule.Name: Ensure other write permissions are removed from Apache files (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Other write access is enabled on Apache directories and files.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Remove write permissions for others from Apache directories and files.

Rule.Name: Ensure CoreDumpDirectory is securely configured (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The CoreDumpDirectory is not set to a secure directory.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Configure CoreDumpDirectory to a secure directory owned by root with 700 permissions.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^CoreDumpDirectory" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^CoreDumpDirectory.*|CoreDumpDirectory "/var/log/apache_coredumps"|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'CoreDumpDirectory "/var/log/apache_coredumps"' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; mkdir -p /var/log/apache_coredumps; chown root:root /var/log/apache_coredumps; chmod 700 /var/log/apache_coredumps; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure lock file directory is secure (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The lock file directory is not secure.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Ensure the lock file directory is owned by root and set to 700 permissions.

Rule.Name: Ensure PID file directory is secure (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The directory for the PID file is not secure.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Ensure the directory containing the PID file is owned by root and set to 700 permissions.

Rule.Name: Ensure ScoreBoard file is securely configured (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The ScoreBoard file is located in an insecure directory.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Configure the ScoreBoard file to reside in a secure directory owned by root with 700 permissions.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^ScoreBoardFile" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && sed -i 's|^ScoreBoardFile .*|ScoreBoardFile "/var/log/apache_scoreboard"|' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf || echo 'ScoreBoardFile "/var/log/apache_scoreboard"' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; touch /var/log/apache_scoreboard; chown root:root /var/log/apache_scoreboard; chmod 700 /var/log/apache_scoreboard; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure group write permissions are removed from Apache files (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Apache directories and files have group write permissions.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Remove group write permissions from Apache directories and files.
Rule.Correction: find /etc/apache2 -type d -perm /g=w -exec chmod g-w {} \; ; find /etc/apache2 -type f -perm /g=w -exec chmod g-w {} \;

Rule.Name: Ensure DocumentRoot files have no group write permissions (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The Document Root directories and files have inappropriate group write access.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Remove group write permissions from Document Root directories and files.
Rule.Correction: find /var/www/html -type d -perm /g=w -exec chmod g-w {} \; ; find /var/www/html -type f -perm /g=w -exec chmod g-w {} \;

Rule.Name: Ensure application writable directories are restricted (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Application writable directories are not properly restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Ensure that writable directories for applications are located outside the DocumentRoot, owned by root, and set with 750 permissions.
